acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for siding corner repair in Daly City, look for local companies with a strong reputation and relevant experience. Check their licensing, insurance, and ask for references from past clients. Review their portfolio for similar siding projects. Ensure they provide a detailed, written estimate outlining the scope of work, materials, and timeline. Prioritize contractors who communicate clearly, offer warranties on their work, and have specific experience with the types of siding prevalent in your area.
